title: Intensive Elementary Persian II
description: Prerequisite: Pre-requisite: PERS105, or equivalent, as determined by the WLPT (World Language Placement Test). Intensive training in spoken and written Persian at elementary level (ACTFL Novice High to Intermediate Low). Continues building basic literacy skills, vocabulary, and grammar through highly a interactive approach. Substantial cultural component familiarizing students with cultural themes related to Iran and the Persian speaking world. Taught in Persian.
